data.description: RED task. Modify plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py: (1) call snapshot_head(repo_root) before first Jira mutation, store pinned SHA; (2) re-invoke snapshot_head before each mutation loop iteration; (3) on mismatch raise HeadDriftError, catch at top-level, call health.emit({kind: abort_due_to_drift}), exit non-zero. Empty mutation queue is no-op. Unit tests: drift mid-pass aborts with correct event kind, exits non-zero, no Jira call after drift, empty pass unchanged.
